stances.quote:

stances.summary: Criticizes ICE agent shooting, condemns administration immigration enforcement
stances.quote:
A young man is dead because an ICE agent pulled the trigger in Biddeford, Maine. He was 26. 

Behind every headline like this is a family whose lives have been shattered. The callousness of this administration's immigration agenda has a body count.

stances.summary: Demands transparency and investigation into ICE officer shooting
stances.quote:
Lorenzo Salgado Araujo was a husband, father, and hardworking member of his community who spent decades building a life for his family. He was shot and killed by an ICE officer on his way to work.

His family deserves transparency, accountability, and an independent investigation

stances.summary: Introduces transparency bill requiring disclosure of extended absences
stances.quote:
When a public official is absent for an extended period of time, the public has a right to an honest explanation.

I'm introducing the Duty of Transparency Act to require Members to disclose extended absences so constituents know where their representative is.

stances.summary: Advocates for public safety improvements in South Bronx
stances.quote: Today, I returned to the Hub in the South Bronx to assess conditions firsthand and ensure the city is following through on the public safety measures I fought for. We must continue working to make this neighborhood safer and stronger for everyone who calls it home.
